sonnet.problem: The card says the prophet says "we have sinned," "counting himself in." The text of verse 24 never says who is speaking, and it gives no reason for the "we." The card guesses both the speaker and why he says "we."
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.
